messages:
hannah: Thinking of a chill Sunset Tea + Micro-Trivia on the terrace next Thursday. 3 small tea flights (green, oolong, herbal), 10-question rounds with tiny prizes. BYO mug or borrow one of ours. :tea: :sunset:
omar: yes please. what time were you thinking? after-work or late afternoon tea?
keisha: 5:30 for me. also can we have a non-caffeinated flight? i'm team sleepy at 6pm.
liam: 5:30 works. i'd volunteer to be trivia MC for the first round. quick poll: 17:00 or 17:30? react with :one: for 17:00, :two: for 17:30.
zara: :two: (17:30 is nicer for sunset vibes)
omar: :two: as well
keisha: :one: (earlier so people with commutes can make it)
hannah: leaning 17:30 if most prefer sunset. we'll keep it short (45 min). Facilities, can terrace be unlocked for 6pm-ish? @facilities
facilities: @hannah we can reserve Terrace East for Thu 17:15-19:00. Please keep noise reasonable and clean up afterwards. Max capacity 40.
hannah: perfect, thank you. I'll put a small RSVP and a slots sheet for tea-flight volunteers and prizes. Prize ideas: a book voucher, extra snacks, or a silly trophy. thoughts?
liam: book voucher + a tiny teapot trophy sounds perfect. i can drop off a used teapot for trophy-crafting.
zara: i'll do one prize (book voucher) and a handwritten note card with tea pairing tips.
omar: i can bring a small speaker and a playlist (no heavy bass). also happy to help with setup.
keisha: i can bring herbal sachets and label caffeine content for each flight.
hannah: lovely. dev-calendar-bot can you make the invite for Thu Jul 28 17:30-18:15 and include RSVP link?
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Sunset Tea + Micro-Trivia (Terrace East)"  
 Thu Jul 28 17:30-18:15  
 RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/tea-trivia-225678
```
Invite: Sunset Tea + Micro-Trivia
When: Thu Jul 28, 17:30-18:15
Where: Terrace East (Building A rooftop)
Notes: BYO mug suggested. Label any allergies. Max 40 people. Volunteer slots: tea flights, prize dropoff, cleanup.
```
hannah: I'll post a Google sheet with slots and a one-question trivia theme poll (general knowledge, pop culture, or science). Liam you're MC for round 1 if that's cool.
liam: happy to MC. i'll do quick buzzer rules (first answer in chat wins tie).
zara: can we do one themed round for silly facts about plants? :seedling:
keisha: love it. small and cozy sounds great. i'll add labels for caffeine and allergens on the tea table.
hannah: thanks all  
 i'll reminder-ping Mon + day-of. See you for tea and tiny brain games! (reaction: :sparkles: :trophy:)
